entities.summary: Natalia Valerievna Fileva was a Russian businesswoman and chairman of the board of directors of S7 Airlines. In 2018, Forbes listed her as the fourth richest woman in Russia, with a worth estimated at US$600 million. She died in a plane crash in Germany in 2019.
